{{Quote|I'm Commander Byten, Imperial Non-human Relations. My men were extracting a key political prisoner from the lower cells. Something went wrong.|Byten|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial Non-human Relations''' was an organization in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] under the [[Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy]] that oversaw the Empire's relationships with [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Byten]] was an officer in the organization, and was tasked with freeing the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] [[Shange]] from imprisonment on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in order to sow chaos among the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-loyal Cathar species.
